scope: Dataset-only pairability audit; no model training.

access.reason: The public Hugging Face API exposes repository metadata but the Dataset Viewer rejects unauthenticated row access.

required_field_assessment.canonical_behavior_or_source_task_id: not present in the published schema
required_field_assessment.attack_or_jailbreak_method_or_style: not present in the published schema
required_field_assessment.harmful_vs_benign_label: not an explicit column; category/tags are not a binary benign-control label
required_field_assessment.context_or_source_identifier: context exists only in contextual/train; it is not a row-level source or behavior identifier

decision: FAIL: the published HarmBench prompt dataset does not expose the repeated behavior-plus-attack-realization structure required for this partition experiment. Authenticated row access would permit verification of the card metadata, but cannot create missing canonical-ID or attack-style fields.
